# AGENTS.md: hand-off for coding agents

This file hands AltiSeek over to a new coding agent (2026-10-27). **CLAUDE.md is the source of
truth** for goals, design, data contracts and working rules. Read it in full before changing
anything. This file only adds where the work stands, how the owner wants you to work, and what
comes next.

## Owner's working rules

- **Commit and push** finished, tested increments to `main` at
  https://github.com/anniketkumar/altiseek.
- **No AI attribution anywhere.** Commits and PRs carry no `Co-Authored-By` lines and no
  "generated by" notes.
- **Never commit dataset imagery** (CLAUDE.md §2). That covers crops, patches, rendered worlds or
  views, caches and checkpoints. `data/` and `runs/` are gitignored. Plots of numbers may go in
  `docs/figures/`.
- **Log deviations.** When the implementation must deviate from CLAUDE.md, update the section and
  add a Decision Log entry (§24) in the same commit. The next free ID is **D36**.
- **Tell the owner** where their input is needed, and give detailed progress updates.
- **Test before committing.** `uv run pytest` runs the tests plus ruff format and lint; all 226
  pass at M5 completion.

## Environment

- Windows 11, Python 3.12 via `uv`, 8 logical CPUs, 16 GB RAM, no local GPU. Use Git Bash or
  PowerShell.
- **Long local jobs:** run them as detached, resumable processes, for example PowerShell
  `Start-Process ... -RedirectStandardOutput data/<stage>/run.log`. A job tied to the agent's
  session dies when the session ends; this happened to the last fidelity run.
- **Memory:** rectifying a 150 m footprint at g0 with 4× supersampling in one call needs several
  GB. Tile it, as `rectified_g0` in `scripts/check_fidelity.py` does.
- **Kaggle** (cloud GPU, D20; see `docs/env.md`):
  - Account `aniketkumarpradhan`, 2× T4. `scripts/kaggle_job.py` pushes a kernel that clones the
    pushed commit, rebuilds the M1 tables, checks the split ID and runs `--run` commands.
  - From Git Bash, prefix commands with `MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1`.
  - The CLI cannot cancel a running kernel.
  - A source kernel's output mounts at `/kaggle/input/notebooks/<user>/<slug>/`.
  - The token lives in `~/.kaggle/access_token`. Never print or commit it. The owner was asked to
    regenerate it.

### What M4 learned, which matters for M5 and M6

- **The detector uses scene context at coarse GSDs.** A swimmer alone on open sea is found less
  often than one among others. Rendered recall at L5 is about 0.5, while real exercise frames
  give about 0.67. This is expected, not a bug (D30, §22).
- **Glint is left out of worlds** (D30). Worlds use conditions 0 and 1, drawn by patch share.
- **Test worlds have no distractors.** T has no usable distractor crops. This is an open decision
  in §25: the owner must decide before M9.
- **Rendered false detections come almost entirely from distractors.** Empty rendered sea gives
  about 0 per view, and so does empty real sea.

## Code map (M4)

- `src/altiseek/geometry/raster.py`: world ↔ g0 raster conversion (row 0 is the north edge).
- `src/altiseek/world/`:
  - `config.py`: library, world and render configs.
  - `appearance.py`: Lab statistics, Reinhard transfer, k-means conditions.
  - `library.py`: patch and crop extraction; `Library.load`, `patch_image`, `crop_image`.
  - `spec.py`: `WorldSpec`, content-addressed; `load` refuses an ID mismatch.
  - `sampler.py`: `prior_grid`, which M7's belief map reuses, and `sample_world`.
  - `render.py`: `compose_world`, `paste`, `render_view`. `render_view` returns the view and the
    ground truth of the objects in it, and is seeded by (world seed, level, ix, iy, variant).
- `configs/world/library.yaml`, `default.yaml`, `render.yaml`.
- `scripts/build_libraries.py`, `generate_worlds.py`, `render_preview.py`, `check_fidelity.py`.
- `LevelTable.lattice(level)` (in `altiseek.geometry.levels`) gives a level's view cells: 121, 49,
  25, 16 and 9 for L1–L5, so 220 views per world.

- Cloud input fix (D32): rebuilt libraries had identical decoded pixels for all 2,807 images,

- CLI remains blocked by Windows code-integrity policy; Smart App Control is off. Browser

## Caveats

- Libraries were built with a dirty working tree; their metadata records commit `2aae40b`.
- The `camera_models.json` hash in library metadata may not match a fresh checkout, because of
  line endings (CRLF vs LF). Compare file contents, not only hashes, before declaring a mismatch.
- Never tune anything on split T, test worlds or test seeds (§23).
